cards.card_text: Suddenly Joseph's sheaf rises and stands upright.
cards.verse_text: We were binding sheaves of grain in the field, and suddenly my sheaf rose and stood upright, while your sheaves gathered around and bowed down to mine.”
cards.snippet: We were binding sheaves of grain in the field, and suddenly my sheaf rose and stood upright, while your sheaves gathered around and bowed down…

cards.card_text: In Joseph's dream, his sheaf of grain stands upright.
cards.verse_text: We were binding sheaves of grain in the field, and suddenly my sheaf rose and stood upright, while your sheaves gathered around and bowed down to mine.”
cards.snippet: We were binding sheaves of grain in the field, and suddenly my sheaf rose and stood upright, while your sheaves gathered around and bowed down…

cards.card_text: When Israel enters the land He's giving them and reaps its harvest, they bring the priest a sheaf of the firstfruits of that harvest.
cards.verse_text: And the LORD said to Moses, “Speak to the Israelites and say, ‘When you enter the land that I am giving you and you reap its harvest, you are to bring to the priest a sheaf of the firstfruits of your harvest.
cards.snippet: …you reap its harvest, you are to bring to the priest a sheaf of the firstfruits of your harvest.

cards.card_text: The priest takes that first sheaf of the harvest.
cards.verse_text: And he shall wave the sheaf before the LORD so that it may be accepted on your behalf; the priest is to wave it on the day after the Sabbath.
cards.snippet: And he shall wave the sheaf before the LORD so that it may be accepted on your behalf;…

cards.card_text: From the day the sheaf is waved, Israel counts off seven full weeks, which is the longest I've ever waited for anything except getting out of a junk drawer.
cards.verse_text: From the day after the Sabbath, the day you brought the sheaf of the wave offering, you are to count off seven full weeks.
cards.snippet: From the day after the Sabbath, the day you brought the sheaf of the wave offering, you are to count off seven full weeks.

cards.card_text: Harvest time: if you forget a sheaf in the field, don't go back for it, and don't go over the olive branches or the grapevines a second time.
cards.verse_text: If you are harvesting in your field and forget a sheaf there, do not go back to get it.
cards.snippet: If you are harvesting in your field and forget a sheaf there, do not go back to get it.

cards.card_text: Leave the forgotten sheaf, so the LORD your God may ___ you in all the work of your hands.
cards.verse_text: If you are harvesting in your field and forget a sheaf there, do not go back to get it.
cards.snippet: If you are harvesting in your field and forget a sheaf there, do not go back to get it.

cards.card_text: Eliphaz says Job will come to the grave like a sheaf of grain gathered in season.
cards.verse_text: You will come to the grave in full vigor, like a sheaf of grain gathered in season.
cards.snippet: You will come to the grave in full vigor, like a sheaf of grain gathered in season.
